request: You—over here! These two won't back off. Can you help me?
help: I'll help. Give me something to fight with.
decline: I can't help. I'm going back.
handoff: Take my knife. Keep your distance when they lower their heads.
tutorial:
WASD to move • J to attack
Step aside when a boar prepares to strike.
thanks: They're down… Thank you. I don't think I could have kept them off much longer.
You could have walked away. I'll remember that you stayed.

You return the borrowed knife.
The Gatherer trusts you much more.
confrontation: Now you come back. I asked for help, and you left me with them.
I dealt with it. Don't expect me to trust you.
defeat:
You fell beneath the boars' tusks.
Retry from the start of the encounter with three hearts. You can choose again.
